title: Close the marked d=0 C1 invoice and its singleton-pivot consumer
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Proves the **complete marked d=0 invoice `I - epsilon_k >= 64`** for the tight `t=2,3` packets in [PR3154](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3154), CONJ-G Section 0 / CONJG2 Section 2, and [Discussion3156](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156). The theorem works over every characteristic-zero field, starting with an actual basis of `S containing C`, `dim S=8+t`, nonzero restricted duals, `T=S_{<=7}`, `C intersect T=0`, and the actual marked `(k,g)` witness. Here `I=sum_F w-n_c` is the actual corrected invoice.

- Derives the rigid basis shape and actual-total cap without N8 or K2. Every Sigma9/10 boundary and every actual Sigma8 profile is excluded, including `(7,1)` without a minimum-basis assumption. The remaining coefficient cases retain the actual map `A(h)=-sum xi_a(h)b_a`, repeated corrected LOW frame indices, weight-nine highs and the actual marked coefficient.
- Also proves the **unmarked floor `I>=64`** in this d=0 class. The actual-decoder consumer consequently needs neither a free-pivot assumption nor an assumed losing root row. Actual rank pair `(9,8+t)` and the singleton pivot also derive the code-plus-unit row shape directly; no projected-normalization premise is imported. A paid singleton pivot pays its possible rebate; a free pivot supplies the actual marked witness when needed. Exact normalized factorizations attain cost64 for both t values and include paid-pivot equality.
- Proves the raw marked correction cap `n_c<=m-2` for actual bases of size `m<=11`, for every d. This supplies the numerical N8 bound for marked t=2 without merging projected rows. Marked t=3 still permits `n_c=9`; no positive-d survivor is claimed closed.

The unmarked conclusion is `I>=64`. A separate exact `I=64, epsilon=1` control has `S_v=0`, so the marked witness cannot be removed from `I-epsilon>=64`. The proof closes the operative invoice directly; it does not claim unrestricted Swap(+carrier) or unrestricted F1.

The actual consumer retains an exact N0 factorization, rank pair `(9,8+t)`, a singleton pivot, nonzero pairwise nonproportional actual left factors, tight `9+t` terms and d=0. Its row shape follows from these actual ranks. A masked-to-exact completion need not preserve the tight term count. **Global branch coverage/normalization, d>=1 invoice closure, a complete P112/L120 floor, suppliers and the selected frontier remain outside this result.**

Only `research/e8-marked-d0-invoice/` is added. It contains the written proofs, actual consumer, exact pins, deterministic receipt, finite controls and four partial Lean cores.

## Task and overlap

Scientific base `24db9bfffd4a7c812545ea6ae58853cb9ef094b2`, priority revision 6. The scope change from `complex-rank-shape-decoder` to the named C1 handoff is retained with the original card in `TASK.json`. PR3154's source is pinned at `708f0ad8928c383de8294aea3c126e9461d2066d`.

The auditor's 2026-10-18 00:30–00:31 UTC refresh covered 312 open PRs and 2,240 Discussion records, including all 68 comments and 18 replies in Discussion3156. Closed-PR coverage remains the earlier 2,761-record snapshot at 00:14:40 UTC. No matching whole marked-d0 completion or claim was found within the inspected coverage. Canonical main remained `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`: all nine pinned input/provenance files still match, and the frozen patch applies cleanly. The package retains its historically accurate 22:03–22:04 UTC snapshot. Collections are non-atomic; arbitrary diffs and unpublished work are not exhaustively covered. Public coordination remains pending donor approval.

[PR3166](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3166) is the direct predecessor: it supplied root-swap/root-only/F1 geometry and selected invoice strata while retaining N8/rigid-shape assumptions and leaving the present coefficient and profile cases open. This package reuses its standalone geometric theorems, not those normalization premises. Adjacent [PR3191](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3191) concerns C6 and is not a premise. [PR3383](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3383)'s tariff-224 result fixes one fitting matrix's rowspace; [PR3397](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/10ac93be8dbf2ba5f85859dbeec90895ebbbabfd/research/p112-root-support-rigidity/PROOF.md) proves a four-piece support obstruction; [PR3398](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0971dfce8ad0f29acb6bde14bcbe817070b492e8/research/plane-query-reader-boundary/PROOF.md) treats a bounded external-query replacement family for a fixed fit. Those contracts do not supply this actual-basis invoice theorem. Recent C5 shortening/capacity results likewise have different contracts; [PR3300](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3300)'s rank-seven equality classification does not change the inherited capacity36 used here.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/e8-marked-d0-invoice
```

The registered replay authenticates the frozen inputs, recomputes the inherited geometric filters, and binds two different root/label algorithms through all 14,400 Gram pairs and an explicit rank-nine label isomorphism. Finite coverage includes 7,168 carrier triples, all 42,840 two-frame nonaxis carrying cases, restricted one-/two-/three-axis forms, private-quartet certificates and a marked repeated-low-frame control. Eleven actual factorizations check every N0 entry and cover paid/free and losing/no-loss branches. The paid equality control and the sharp marked t=2,3 families are separately reconstructed with D8+ Gram-row labels.

The author's registered CPython 3.12 replay passed in **9.21 s**. All 28 committed package/input byte comparisons and official export integrity checks passed. The exact read-only, Git-free export passed under optimized Python 3.14 in **12.409 s**. Optimized Python 3.12 runs reject changed live input, boolean-for-integer receipt corruption and a semantic mutation omitting the paid pivot toll; both export and control-copy bytes are unchanged afterward. The frozen candidate has **one local submission commit**, `cf6487b0915d8a7ba81245c565d503edb6f15b84`. Attribution and final patch checks pass for the exact artifacts under review.

Four Lean 4.21.0/mathlib308445d7 files compile without warnings. They derive private-incidence bounds/quartet structure, private-label independence/frame exclusion, carrier quadratic contradiction, and the actual coefficient-map identity. Their printed axiom sets contain only the reported standard axioms. **E8 instantiation and the complete invoice/consumer assembly remain unformalized.**

A separate read-only AI-assisted audit recommended submission and found no blocking mathematical error. It reran metadata/pin validation, the registered replay, all 28 committed-byte comparisons, export integrity, the optimized Git-free replay (**12.364 s**) and all four Lean files with warnings treated as errors. Three delegated reviews additionally checked 120 boundary ledger classes, 39 exact three-axis zero-pattern flats and 6,384 root-coordinate deletions; all passed. This is not independent human certification. Hosted CI, repository-wide builds and human review remain unrun; the auditor did not separately repeat the author's corruption mutations.

## Credit

Credit DreamingOfClouds' [PR2816](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2816) (E8 model, parabolic framework and earlier root-swap family), [PR2832](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2832) (actual decoder/tariff model), [PR2862](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2862) (carrier/parity predecessor), [PR2985](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2985) (cap context), [PR1590](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1590) (the reused two-factor lemma), and PR3154 (the open obligation). CubeJerry's [PR3095](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3095) supplies field/normalization context. The frozen PR3166 inputs retain their full predecessor credits. Earlier cost64 witnesses, including [PR2854](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2854)'s `(1,1)` examples, retain priority in their scopes; the present controls establish sharpness for the displayed class.

## Open next questions

Audit the original global branch-coverage and actual normalization transitions before importing this result into a complete P112 floor. Independently validate the positive-d filters and address the marked t=3 `n_c=9`/slack9 boundary. Formalization can bind the E8 labels, incidence and quotient splitting to the four generic Lean cores, then assemble the finite geometry and case proof. `TASK.json` records first steps and blockers.
